notes.title: 2025 and beyond
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It’s been a while, so here’s the latest on what’s going on! 
Let’s start with the fun stuff.

[h2]Pricing:[/h2]
To continue delivering high-quality gaming experiences, I will be adjusting the price of all arcade titles to better reflect the value and effort behind them.

Starting early 2025, all titles will be priced at [b]$7.99 USD[/b] (or your local currency equivalent). This adjustment will apply across all stores and platforms.

On the bright side, this change allows for [b]higher seasonal discounts[/b] and even better [b]bundle deals[/b], so keep an eye out for those!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323193/090682c02d6b161135e7117c7b0de94ab626c81e.png[/img]

[h2]Soundtracks:[/h2]
Unrelated to the price update (though potentially beneficial too) is the news that I’ll soon be releasing [b]game soundtracks[/b] as downloadable content (DLC). This is something many of you have been requesting for a while, and I’m happy to finally make it happen.

Starting in early 2025, soundtracks will be available on the store pages for all my games, [b]except Donut Dodo[/b]. This also means that future ports of Donut Dodo, most notably for legacy consoles, will feature a completely new soundtrack!

[h2]Donut Dodo Updates:[/h2]
While [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1779560/Donut_Dodo/]Donut Dodo[/url] is [b]content complete[/b] and will remain so, I had planned to bring over some quality-of-life improvements from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225830/Cash_Cow_DX/]Cash Cow DX[/url], like a practice mode and additional options.

Unfortunately, updating the game to the latest engine version failed miserably, and after several months of effort, the project is currently on hold. I haven’t given up, though, and I’ll revisit this in the near future and look for alternative solutions (including rewriting the game without an engine).

[h2]2025 and Beyond:[/h2]
There’s so much exciting stuff on the horizon and 2025 is shaping up to be a fantastic year for arcade gaming! While most of my projects remain under wraps for now, I can share that my upcoming party arcade game, [b]Looney Landers[/b], is progressing nicely.

Mark your calendars: the game is on track for release on [b]February 5th, 2025[/b]. 
[b]If you haven’t already, feel free to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169660/Looney_Landers/]wishlist it here[/url]![/b]


Thanks for your continued support, and as always, take care!

notes.title: Coming soon: Looney Landers
notes.notes:
Following Donut Dodo and Cash Cow DX, [b]Looney Landers[/b] is the third title in the Class of 1983 arcade trilogy.

Looney Landers is a short and goofy classic arcade party game, for 1-2 players. Compete against friends, family, or the CPU to claim the top spot on the leaderboards in this score-chasing frenzy.

The game combines elements from Sky Diver (Atari, 1978), Sky Skipper (Nintendo, 1981) and Peggle (PopCap, 2007) to deliver an utterly wonky gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323193/054ae1bea17fee254c66b4edec99424e11ce4e5a.png[/img]

You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169660/Looney_Landers/]wishlist Looney Landers here[/url].

Thank you for the support!

notes.title: Donut Dodo 1.39 has landed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323193/c406451f3a7f888ea86305377986a5a0eb2e758e.png[/img]

[h2]Game update[/h2]

So, version 1.39 of Donut Dodo has landed!
What does that mean?

Well, from a cosmetic point of view, there have been no changes.
But under the hood, there have been many fixes and code optimizations.
The game should now also support most if not all current gen arcade sticks.

[h2]Trading Cards[/h2]

Other than that, Trading Cards and other goodies are now finally available.
You have been requesting these repeatedly, and rightly so!
Sorry for taking forever to get them done. Better late than never.

Some of the goodies can be accessed directly via the Points Shop here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1779560]Donut Dodo - Points Shop[/url]
Cards and other rare items will drop during gameplay.

[h2]Steam Deck[/h2]

This is also a good opportunity to address the Steam Deck issues some players have been experiencing.
One player kindly got in touch to say that disabling the Steam Performance Overlay solved all freezing issues on game start, as this seems to be impacting the renderer.

In other words, the game is fully compatible with the Deck, as long as the Performance Overlay is disabled.

That’s it for now.
Thanks to all of you for playing Donut Dodo.
Happy gaming, trading and collecting!

notes.title: v1.31 - New Arcade Bezels, Fixes & Optimizations
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323193/c45e4ddd27fb9c0da8aa29a475a3f20be8c68759.jpg[/img]

There have been a couple of recent updates to Donut Dodo, so it's about time to list what is new or what issues have been addressed.

[b]Bezel:[/b]
Most notably, from a visual point of view, the game has received an illustrated 80s style arcade bezel. To accompany it, new bezel options have been added to the settings menu, where you can choose between different designs or turn them off altogether.

[b]Weekly Challenge:[/b]
The weekly challenge was not always resetting correctly, to be in synch with the online leaderboards. This has been addressed and hopefully fixed for good.

[b]Arcade Shortcuts:[/b]
Many are playing Donut Dodo on their arcade cabinet, and have been requesting that "Add Credit" and "1P Start" are mapped to keys "5" and "1" respectively, like in MAME. This should have been straightforward, but the main menu had to be rebuilt for this to work correctly. The feature is now fully implemented.

[b]Optimizations:[/b]
Most players will likely not notice this, but the game now uses 50% less RAM and 20% less CPU power, making it more snappy and responsive on older hardware.

Other than that, some minor fixes were worked on here and there, for an overall better experience.

Keep those amazing scores coming! The world record is now just under 400K!
Thanks again for all your kind feedback, and happy gaming with Donut Dodo!

notes.title: v1.24 - Online Arcade Leaderbooards, Weekly Challenge & Extra Achievements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323193/04542ca59510a2fb14a9e5a5b0f9e17b4019a287.png[/img]

It has been about a month since Donut Dodo was released, and so much has happened since.

First of all, you guys have been amazing. Your feedback has really helped iron out bugs and your great suggestions have helped make the game it is today. Thank you!

While there have been dozens of fixes and optimizations in recent patches, v1.24 is the biggest one to date. This new release brings much anticipated [b]cross-platform online leaderboards[/b], arcade style, for even more hi-score madness.

At the same time, the [b]Weekly Challenge[/b], a hi-score table that resets weekly, has gone live. This will give everyone a shot at being featured in the Hall of Fame.

Also, the [b]input detection[/b] has been completely reprogrammed, as some players had issues with d-pad controls. This should also make the game support more joysticks, as many of you are playing Donut Dodo on your arcade machines.

Other community requests have been implemented, such as the ability to [b]restart[/b] the game from the pause menu, choose between different [b]CRT filters[/b] or [b]reset[/b] the local scoreboards. Two extra [b]achievements[/b] have now also been implemented.

Thanks again for all your kind feedback, and happy gaming with Donut Dodo!

notes.title: Donut Dodo v1.08 - out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323193/212501907eea5160b5ae4446d6e13831af267d41.jpg[/img]
Beautiful Donut Dodo illustration by Greg Pugh - [url=https://twitter.com/GPAnimations]@GPAnimations[/url]

Hey all!

It has almost been a week since we released Donut Dodo... and what a week it has been.
Thank you so much for all your amazing feedback and very kind compliments.
Your valuable feedback has no doubt helped make Donut Dodo the game it is today!

[b]Speaking of which:[/b]
We have just pushed out v1.08 that addresses quite a few quality of life upgrades, corrected some gameplay aspects, such as making the Ferris Wheel more "sticky", but most importantly, we have fixed a nasty bug in the Sugar Rush Speedrun leaderboards. These should now work correctly, both online and offline.

[b]What next?[/b]
We are working hard to implement cross-platform leaderboards (on top of keeping Steam leaderboards), for even more traffic and competition. One of these leaderboards is the Daily Challenge, which will be unlocked at the same time.

[b]Arcade cabinets[/b]
Also, many of you have successfully managed to get Donut Dodo up and running in your multicades and other fun hardware. Some of you have display issues in very low resolutions on old CRT monitors. While we only have access 2 CRT screens for testing, we will look into it and try to come up with a solution.

Take care and have fun with Donut Dodo!
